responses.sql: SELECT AVG(wins) FROM driverStandings WHERE points >= 1

assumptions.assumption: Each driverStandings row (one driver at one race) counts as one entry, so the average is taken over all rows with points >= 1, not per driver or per season. Rows with NULL wins are ignored by AVG.
